nodes.summary: For a self-map $f$ of a set $X$ and a point $x \in X$, the forward orbit of $x$ under $f$ is the set $\{f^n(x) : n \in \mathbb{N}\}$ of all iterates of $x$, including $f^0(x) = x$.
nodes.title: Forward orbit

nodes.summary: For a self-map $f$ of a set $X$, points $x, y \in X$ are related, that is, lie in the same grand orbit of $f$, when $f^m(x) = f^n(y)$ for some natural numbers $m$ and $n$.
nodes.title: Grand orbit relation

nodes.summary: For a self-map $f$ of a set $X$, the relation on $X$ in which $x \sim y$ when $f^m(x) = f^n(y)$ for some natural numbers $m$ and $n$ is an equivalence relation; its equivalence classes are the grand orbits of $f$.
nodes.title: Grand orbit equivalence relation

nodes.summary: For a self-map $f$ of a set $X$ and a point $x \in X$, the grand orbit of $x$ is the set of all $y \in X$ such that $f^m(x) = f^n(y)$ for some natural numbers $m$ and $n$, that is, the equivalence class of $x$ under the grand orbit relation.
nodes.title: Grand orbit

nodes.summary: Let $f$ be a self-map of a set $X$ and let $m$ and $n$ be natural numbers. A point $x \in X$ is preperiodic of type $(m, n)$ when $n > 0$ and $f^{m+n}(x) = f^m(x)$, that is, $f^m(x)$ is periodic with period $n$. Neither $m$ nor $n$ is required to be minimal.
nodes.title: Preperiodic point of a given type

nodes.summary: A point $x$ is preperiodic for a self-map $f$ when its forward orbit $\{f^n(x) : n \in \mathbb{N}\}$ under $f$ is a finite set.
nodes.title: Preperiodic point

nodes.summary: A point $x$ is strictly preperiodic for a self-map $f$ when it is preperiodic for $f$ but not periodic, that is, there is no $n > 0$ with $f^n(x) = x$.
nodes.title: Strictly preperiodic point

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
